decisions.reason: The candidate already has a complete message-160 MODIFY requiring complete-wordmark exploration to preserve the locked Hero V, second V, and É accent; no additional update or removal is needed.
The candidate already has a message-160 MODIFY recording the second V as locked and requiring it to remain unchanged unless the client explicitly requests a change.
The Hero V was already approved and locked, and its message-160 MODIFY adds the required unchanged-unless-explicitly-requested revision policy.
The candidate already has a complete message-160 MODIFY establishing that internal-letter exploration must occur around the three locked assets while preserving them unchanged.
The candidate already has a message-160 MODIFY marking the approved É accent as locked and requiring it to be carried forward unchanged unless explicitly changed by the client.
Locking the three geometric assets does not change the deferred champagne-metal material treatment, its qualities, or its sequencing after geometry resolution.
The asset revision policy does not alter the broader brand-purpose, emotional-expression, positioning, or luxury-character requirements.
Locking the Hero V, second V, and É accent does not change the decision to use a proprietary wordmark without a separate icon or monogram.
